title: bzf project root
description: The project's root document, `project.json`: the frame every plan coordinate is in, and the buildings and plan states it holds. This schema describes documents of schema version 1.x; a document of another major version is only required to say which.

id.description: The project's id, as its project file says.

language.description: The language of the project's free text (labels, names, notes, descriptions, reasons), as a BCP 47 tag: "de", "de-AT". Keys and listed values are English in every language; only what people write is in this one.

classes.description: The class of the apps' own documents by path prefix ("energieberatung/": "building"), so that a share leaves out what may not leave the organisation. The documents this spec defines have their class in their schema; an app's document without one here counts as party data and stays.

needs.description: The lowest app version that reads everything in the project, once something needs a newer one than the schema version says.

frame.description: The project's frame, fixed when the project is created: plan coordinates are integer millimetres in it and heights are relative to its ±0,00. Each source has its own transform into it. With `origin` and `crs` it is a local engineering frame with a map conversion, as IFC's IfcMapConversion.

north.description: The compass bearing of the frame's +y axis, degrees clockwise from north: 0 when +y points north, 90 when east.

northConfirmed.description: Whether `north` was confirmed or aligned with LoD2; until then it is what the plans' north arrow gives where `northSource` names one, else the assumption that up in the plan is north.

northSource.description: The north arrow `north` was read from: its plan state, file, layer and entity. Absent while north is assumed or LoD2's.

origin.description: Where the frame's origin lies, metres (easting, northing) in `crs`, where known.

crs.description: The coordinate reference system of `origin`: "EPSG:25832" (ETRS89 / UTM 32N).

datum.description: The height of ±0,00 above sea level (NHN), metres, where known.
